content.short: Kwenta is a DeFi platform built on the Synthetix protocol enabling trading of synthetic assets.
content.description: Kwenta is a DeFi trading platform built on the Synthetix protocol that lets users trade synthetic assets—tokenized derivatives that mirror the value of other assets. The platform runs on Optimism, a Layer 2 solution for Ethereum, providing lower gas costs and greater scalability. Kwenta offers isolated margin trading with up to 25x leverage and uses a hybrid oracle that combines Chainlink and PYTH to determine asset prices. Traders deposit sUSD and must meet a $40 minimum deposit to incentivize timely liquidations.
